steps.now: 兔儿爷 has heard of a spirit that loves learning. Start at 天坛 — line 5 to 天坛东门.
steps.past: Went to 天坛, where the emperors prayed for rain.

steps.now: 小明's class is on a school trip to 天坛 today (school hours)! Find him in the park, near the east gate.
steps.past: Met 小明 on his school trip; he gave me 《天坛》.

steps.now: Go north up to the Hall of Prayer 祈年殿. 小明's teacher is asking the class a question — 《天坛》 page 3 knows the answer.
steps.past: Answered the teacher at the 祈年殿: the roof is blue, the colour of the sky.

steps.now: 《天坛》 pages 5–6: in the south, on the round altar 圜丘, stand on the centre stone 天心石 and say something.
steps.past: Stood on the 天心石 and heard my own voice come back from all round.

steps.now: At the Echo Wall 回音壁, east of the Hall of Prayer, a boy wants to whisper you a secret through the wall. Talk to him, then put your ear to the wall.
steps.past: Put my ear to the Echo Wall and heard a whisper.

steps.now: The whisper said 国子监. Ride line 5 north to 雍和宫 and walk along 国子监街 to the Academy's gate.
steps.past: Walked along 国子监街 to the old Academy's gate.

steps.now: 国子监街 still has its old 牌楼, the painted gateways across the street. Look up at one and read it.
steps.past: Read the 牌楼 over 国子监街.

steps.now: The old scholar at 国子监 knows the history of the Academy.
steps.past: The old scholar gave me 《科举》, about the imperial exams.

steps.now: Next door in the 孔庙, the 进士 names are carved on stone steles. Look at one — 兔儿爷 will ask how many names there are (《科举》 page 6).
steps.past: Looked at the 进士 steles in the 孔庙: more than fifty thousand names.

steps.now: Back at 国子监, 孔先生 has a saying from 孔子 for you.
steps.past: 孔先生 taught me 「三人行，必有我师」.

steps.now: The bronze 麒麟 in the Academy's courtyard wakes at dusk. Come after five in the afternoon.
steps.past: Waited for dusk in the Academy courtyard and met the 麒麟.

title: 毽子 with the grannies
blurb: The grannies at 天坛 kick a 毽子 every day and count every kick.
lead: Grannies at 天坛 are counting out loud.

steps.now: Kick the 毽子 with the grannies at 天坛 — count with them.
steps.past: Kicked the 毽子 with the grannies at 天坛.

title: A song at 天坛
blurb: An old man plays the 胡琴 at 天坛 and wants someone to sing along.
lead: Music from a 胡琴 floats across the 天坛 park.

steps.now: The old man with the 胡琴 wants you to sing a line with him.
steps.past: Sang a line with the 胡琴 player.

title: Hot water for the 胡琴 player
blurb: The 胡琴 player's hands are cold. Hot water would help him play.
lead: The 胡琴 player at 天坛 keeps rubbing his hands.

steps.now: The old 胡琴 player is cold. Buy a thermos 保温杯 at the corner shop on 南锣鼓巷.
steps.past: Bought a thermos at the corner shop.

steps.now: Fill it with hot water at 老刘’s teahouse (use the flask on him).
steps.past: Filled it with hot water at 老刘's.

steps.now: Give the hot water to the old man at 天坛 (use it on him).
steps.past: Gave the old man hot water — he played better than ever.

title: Water writing 地书
blurb: An old man writes characters on the ground with water; they fade as he writes.
lead: An old man at 天坛 writes on the ground with a long brush.

steps.now: Write with water beside the old man in the 天坛 park.
steps.past: Wrote with water beside the old man at 天坛.

title: A kite at 天坛
blurb: On windy days a kite maker sells his kites in the 天坛 park.
lead: On windy days kites fly over 天坛.

steps.now: On a windy day the kite maker is in the 天坛 park. Pick the kite he describes.
steps.past: Picked the kite the kite maker described.

title: The diabolo
blurb: A grandmother at 天坛 spins a humming diabolo and teaches anyone who asks.
lead: Something hums like a bee in the 天坛 park.

steps.now: The grandmother in the 天坛 park teaches the 空竹 — do what she says.
steps.past: Spun the 空竹 with the grandmother.
